repo.description: The repository name (path) on this DID account.

refName.description: The full ref name, e.g. refs/heads/main.

objectId.description: The hex SHA-256 object ID this ref points to.

main.description: A did-git ref stored in an AT Protocol repository. Each record maps a repository name and ref name (e.g. refs/heads/main) to the hex SHA-256 object ID it points to.
